newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close slightly down ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close slightly down ahead of weekend.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended slightly down as pharmaceutical, Engineering and textile sectors performed badly with most scrips falling ahead of the weekend, brokers.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index lost 2.25 points or 0.24 percent to 922.77 on turnover of 44.9 million taka. Losers led gainers by 63 to 61 with five unchanged.
Brokers said the index was not much affected despite fall in majority shares and many of blue chips in engineering and other sectors.
This is mainly because of the gain of Niloy Cement Industries by almost 100 percent in its debut, said one broker.
The 100 taka Niloy Cement share was traded at 199.25 taka on a volume of 14,300 shares.

"The market may consolidate slighty when it resumes on Sunday as investors are likely to return seeing many of the shares reached to their bottom in a lingering bearish spell," said Mohammad Ashraf of Mahbub Morshed & Company.
Aziz Pipes gained 11.5 taka to 999.4, Bangladesh Lamps rose 26.26 to 4,407.23 and Glaxo Bangladesh shed 1.0 to 109.5.
